subject: Post-discovery: next steps & dedicated-capacity sizing workshop
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@brighthost.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Mar 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: next steps & dedicated-capacity sizing workshop

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn more about BrightHost's ingestion pipeline and how latency spikes on peak hours are affecting your summarization and customer-notifications flows. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can lock a technical deep-dive / capacity-sizing workshop:  

Recap (from our side)
- Primary workload: nightly batch > real-time fanout; majority of tokens per request ~400-1,200.
- Critical path: notification summarization (P95 latency target <400ms) and interactive admin queries (target <300ms).
- Expected concurrency: 60 sustained qps during peak window, occasional bursts to 180 qps for ~10–15 minutes.

Proposed next steps
1) Dedicated Capacity Sizing Workshop (technical deep-dive) — meet with your infra/devs + our serving engineers. We will: review token distribution, walk a quick synthetic load test plan, and map to GPU pool sizing and batching policy.
2) Share a short sizing template (attached) you can populate with recent load stats and a short sample corpus to help us calibrate throughput/latency estimates.
3) Agree on an agenda and calendar slot. Suggested slots (PDT):
   • Tues Mar 22 — 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
   • Wed Mar 23 — 09:00–10:30 or 15:00–16:30

Can you confirm which slot works, and please include the two engineers who would attend (we recommend someone who owns the inference service and someone who owns traffic/ingest). If it helps, here's a Calendly link with our open windows: https://calendly.com/redwood/60min-sizing-workshop

Attached: redwood-scaling-scorer-template.xlsx (token distribution + sample corpus tab), mutual-action-plan.docx (high-level milestones).

Thanks — I’ll loop Ben (solutions lead) on the invite so we have the right engineer coverage.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Thanks for the recap, this matches our notes. We can confirm the following from our side:
- Primary attendees: myself, Tom Li (Infra lead) and Priya Verma (ML infra). I’ll forward the calendar invite to Priya once we lock a time.
- Quick answers to the sizing template fields:
  • Typical request tokens: 350–1,100 (99th ~1,500 for long sessions)
  • Peak sustained qps: ~55–70; peaks today hit 160 for ~12 minutes during flash sales.
  • Current P95 latency on our baseline model (self-hosted): ~520ms; goal is to get under 400ms with acceptable cost.

We’re available: 
- Tue Mar 22 10:00–11:30 (works best)
- Wed Mar 23 15:00–16:30 (backup)

A couple of quick asks before the call:
1) Can you share a short workshop agenda so Tom knows what to prepare (perf counters, load generator access, sample payload format)?
2) Do you have a brief note about networking requirements for Private deployments (VPC peering / egress rules)? Our security team will want to confirm.

Also cc’ing Tom so he can weigh-in on availability and whether we need to bring our infra manager.

Thanks — I’ll accept the 10:00 slot if you confirm.

—Alicia
